notes.title: ✨New Year, New Patch!✨
notes.content:
Happy New Year!, adventurers!🎉

We’re releasing what will be the final update for now. Over the past months, we’ve worked tirelessly since the game’s release—deploying patches and rolling out hotfixes as soon as you, the players, reported issues. Every negative review rooted in technical or design flaws has been addressed and resolved. The game is now very stable, your feedback has been heard and implemented, and what’s left on our list is more about  fine-tuning than fixing disruptive problems.

But, for now, we won’t be able to release more updates for the game. The team is focusing on other projects that need our care and attention to help us grow and stay afloat in this wild world of game development. While we love that the game is free (and we know you do too), we’ve got to keep the lights on! We hope you understand this decision.❤️ That said, new updates aren’t completely off the table. If the moment comes when the studio has the opportunity and stability to add new content to eWorlds, we’ll be sure to do so.

Moving on to the game update, this one is to pre-mitigate bad experiences while unlocking achievements, and to give some interactables the in-game behaviour that was expected from them. 

The most important change is the fact that we removed the 2 player minimum in battle modes. Now you can play solo and get Medals on Gamergy is Lava and Alienware Arena, or practice the Stages in Coliseum. This way, farming coins should be easier and you can discover a new aspect of the game, while not depending on a high Concurrent Players Count. We strongly recommend playing these modes with a friend, though.

So let’s roll the full list:

 Reduced the minimum players for battle modes from 2 to 1.
 Gave Evil Tulips (purple shooting plants) a death trigger so you cannot just run through them.
 Adjusted Space HUB props so some World Portals are more easily visible.
 Adjusted a platforming section in Cave Trial to make the “Serpent Route” easier after obtaining the Loop.
 Visual Update to the Crane Model.
 Improved Remote Players real time synchronization.
 Adjusted some colliders in El Salvador’s rooftops.
 Interface SFX corrections.
 Increased the area where the Bomb SFX could be heard.
 Fixed some incorrect Sounds that could be heard while stepping on certain materials.
 Increased Scroll speed in the Store.
 Improved Coin materials and reflections on various maps.
 Adjusted lighting on Western Run.

And… That’s all, folks! Before we go, we want to take a moment to say a huge thank you to every single one of you. Your support, feedback, and passion have meant the world to us. This game has been a journey we’ve shared together, and it wouldn’t be what it is today without this incredible community. While this marks the end of updates, we’re so proud of what we’ve built and how you’ve embraced it. Please keep sharing your adventures, memories, and love for the game—we’ll always treasure it. 💖

Thank you for being part of this world. See you around on our Official eWorlds Discord and Steam Discussions. You’re the best!

The GGTech Studios Team. ❤️

notes.title: Fixes and New Bonus Level!✨
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers! 🚀

In our last patches we’ve added features a lot of you asked for: Achievements, more graphic settings, QoL improvements… Now it’s time to bring you a new experience inside eWorlds, with a new Time Trial World accessible for everyone, and for free!

Today, we bring you a Bonus World so you can have fun clearing its Challenges: Intel Speedrun can be accessed from a Portal in Space HUB , and it is a “Loopless” world where you can compete in its Time Trial to get many coins, plus a brand new skin.  The map features 25 Abstract Stages in an environment which resembles a Processing unit,  where you will need to pick up the Ultra Processors to gain a Speed Boost and be able to jump the lengthy distances between checkpoints. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44412855/82ef30d8b116357c7a390fa4e4baedc0f0f10059.gif

Remember you can upload your time to Speedrun.com (you’ll need graphic proof of your run) to compete asynchronously with the best players. 


As always, we have been polishing the hard edges of the game and you will find many tweaks and minor fixes. Here you have a list of the fixes issued in this patch:


 New Bonus World: Intel Speedrun.
 Solved two possible Stuck points in Western Run.
 Fixed Jumping animations while on a Trampoline.
 Removed clipping in a section of Manor Island.
 Updated the Crane model (if you find any issues with it please report to us in our Discord!)
 Enlarged some triggers in the Proximity platform sections
 Enlarged the sound area of the bomb
 Minor sfx fixes


That's it for now! We hope you enjoy the new World, find the changes a positive move and keep playing eWorlds with your friends. See you in our Official eWorlds discord or in the Steam Discussions and we will keep in touch about any proposal or bug you may find. 

Have fun!
The GGTech Studios Team.❤️

notes.title: eWorlds Steam Achievements and more! 🌟
notes.content:
Hello, Adventurers!🚀

This week we bring you a new patch which adds some new features, plus a few fixes and improvements!💜

Most important updates:

We've added Steam Achievements!✨
[hr][/hr]We've got a few comments asking for them...  so we are finally implementing Steam Achievements! From today you would be able to unlock 29 achievements, some of them hidden... ready to unlock them all?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44412855/81939bf523f7ed32d504a49fbf006d6df70753d5.png

Important note: If you've already completed the game, the achievements you've managed to get will appear automatically as unlocked in your achievement list.

Invert controls and FPS settings 🎮
[hr][/hr]Some of you reported that you were used to play with inverted controls, so we've implemented invert control settings for those who need to change them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44412855/65a158874a7438500ac1c21ced4cad3b751fd315.png

And also as we told you in the previous patch, you can now set your FPS limit at various ranges in the settings, we wish this also helps with the motion sickness issues some players reported to have.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44412855/5178b3f022b9e2c1bc42690e298464bfb68eb59e.png

Unstuck button 🏃‍♂️
[hr][/hr]Have you been having trouble getting stuck in some place of the game and don't know how to fix it without returning to the HUB and losing your progress? don't worry! We've implemented a ''unstuck'' option in the main menu of the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44412855/d9c40580e20f886920c0c9e331ef01b2fc2f836d.png

New HUD perspective 📐
[hr][/hr]But why changing the perspective of the HUD? For you to know about the context of this change, in the original designs of the eWorlds UI we had this perspective added to it, with the idea of making it more immersive, similar to other spacial themed games have, we never got to implement it due to prioritizing other developments, and we are releasing it today! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44412855/9894ab32b2b95ca6e153b0475a7cee3a6af097a8.png

Important note: We acknowledge that you will maybe find this change strange, above all if you were already used to the old UI. If that's the case, please let us know, we have no problem on bringin it back to the old one if you feel uncomfortable with it.

Gold Fever! 💰[hr][/hr]Also, we've added many coins to every map, so while you play, you'll find it easier to earn them in order to complete your wardrobe!

Eight NEW Skin Pieces 👠[hr][/hr]
We've implemented a few new skin pieces for you to show your style! 
You'll find the Five new Head pieces and Three new Body pieces in the store to complete your collection!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44412855/9d1937c53bf9e6ec0b82ea5f8fd55934e6e3fa4a.png



With these points out of the way, here you have the full list of fixes for today’s update:


 29 Steam Achievements.
 8 New Skin pieces Available.
 Added options for Invert controls to settings.
 Added FPS limiter to settings.
 Added unstuck option on the menu.
 Added perspective to the HUD.
 Added more coins to the maps.
 Added VFX to the stun effect.
 Platforming improvements on cave trial cliff zone.
 Navigation improvements on store carrousel.
 Fixed the Hammer acceleration while jumping and using it.
 Changed Emote button in gamepad, now you can use it pressing on the Right Stick.
 Minor UI Fixes.
 Minor SFX Fixes.


We hope you enjoy these fixes, let us know what you think about them or if you have any questions. Thanks a lot for playing, see you around!✨

If you experience any issues, contact us via Official eWorlds discord, Steam Discussions or if you have any other feedback you can use this Feedback Form.  

Thanks,

notes.title: Single Player Mode, avoiding Motion Sickness and a lot of little fixes!🔧
notes.content:
Hello, Adventurers!🚀

This week we bring you a new patch which adds some features the community requested, plus fixes and improvements as usual. 

But before, we wanted to apologize for the Technical issues early this week. We received a lot of traffic (thank you for playing by the way) and our server provider blocked incoming requests, so many of you may have run into “Server under maintenance” message. Also, we found some players accessing eWorlds from and outdated launcher inside Steam, and this caused many players to be unable to use portals, get Loops, or even just Spawn in their desired Worlds. For this reason we include now a "Version check" when launching eWorlds, so this should be fixed already but if you do find this message anytime please let us know in our Discord.

Now, for the patch notes!

VSYNC Setting
[hr][/hr]For starters, we’ve tried to address the motion Sickness some of you have reported, as it makes the experience really poor to players who suffer from it.
To tackle that, we already offer the possibility to adjust Field of View (FOV) in settings, and in this patch we’ve added a Setting to disable VSYNC. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44412855/db07ffe5fc78d535111dad0eaae0e3682635fbe1.png

If these still don’t work for you, we’ll let you know we are working right now on a setting to offer FPS limits at various ranges, as inconsistent or too high FPS can also result in motion sickness for some players. This will come in the next patch!

Single Payer Mode[hr][/hr]We’ve seen some players struggle when other, more experienced players griefed them with the Hammer, or distracted them in various ways, as in the end, eWorlds is a Multiplayer Online Game. Although it goes “against” eWorlds initial design, we now offer the possibility to play without seeing or interacting with other players. 
Just go to Settings, check “Single Player Mode” and the game will create a private Lobby for you.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44412855/91e07ceb3dd11620f7cc33872333e71e6601ca01.png

At the moment you cannot join friends in private Lobbies but this setting will allow you to play at your own pace, to just complete the game… Or to set new Best Times in your favourite Time Trials. Thanks to a dedicated community member (❤️) eWorlds now has an entry on Speedrun.com, so if you are motivated to beat the best times, head there, and share your gameplay!

Coliseum Battle system off[hr][/hr]Before, you were forced to jump into battle while there were at least 2 players in the room, and this could be frustrating for players trying to complete the 5 Loops. Now, players who want to battle will need to stay inside the “Battle Ready Area”, and only they will be teleported to the Arenas, leaving “non-competitive players” out so they can search for Loops. 

Non-PVP Areas Setting[hr][/hr]And, for all of you who love a real challenge, you now can select an option to Disable “Non-PVP Areas”. This way, the Platforming Sections that deactivate PVP by default won’t have an effect on players who activate this option, so they can fight each other on every corner of eWorlds. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44412855/093163f4892a68ceac36bab5e1651b60a303edcc.png

In this Platforming Sections, players with the Non-PVP Areas ''Deactivated'' will have their name in red, and will be able to use violence against other players in red, while players with the Setting "Activated" will be affected normally by them and be invulnerable to other players powerups.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44412855/fe85f4b632f62f349392ddd14adf830ef5f8458b.png

With these points out of the way, here you have the full list of fixes for today’s update:

 Added VSYNC toggle to settings.
 Added Single Player Mode.
 Now, Coliseum does not take you into the Battle zone while you stay out of the battle ready Area.
 Added "Non PvP Areas" Toggle to settings.. 
 Reworked Platforming Section on Space HUB to make recovery easier. 
 Now, when launching eWorlds for the first time, the game should automatically select your native Steam Language. Still you can change the Language from Settings. 
 Reduced greatly the Grappling Hook cooldown so you can use it again faster after shooting it. 
 Fixed a bug where NPC dialogues would appear without their names. 
 Fixed a bug that wouldn't allow to close the chat pressing ESC.
 Fixed a bug where you didn't get the Silver Rafa skin after Obtaining the Golden Loop.
 Adjusted the position of many props and shadows that were slightly off. 
 Adjusted round times in Battle modes so now there is less time between rounds.
Now you can see in which worlds you can find each Powerup by opening the Progression Map on Space HUB.
Now you can access the Tutorial again from the Settings Menu by pressing F1 or Select.
 Now, when you Start eWorlds, it will check if your version is up to date. If it is not, a pop-up will tell you to update the game.


We hope you like these fixes, as we are working hard on improving eWorlds after its release to please as many of you as possible and overall make a better game. Thank you for playing, see you around!✨

If you experience any issues, contact us via Official eWorlds discord, Steam Discussions or if you have any other feedback you can use this Feedback Form.  

Thanks,
The GGTech Studios Team.❤️

notes.title: New Content and Release Date!✨
notes.content:
Attention, adventurers! 🚀

As we told you a few weeks ago, we have been working on very important changes for eWorlds, giving a new approach to the game and focusing on a more compact and polished experience.

Today, we want to share with you all the details of this update, which will be available at the launch of eWorlds... 

October 25th!🎉

🎮 A tribute to collectathons fans

If you love classic, collectathon-style platform games, you're in luck. We've worked on creating a little love letter to those games that marked an era, and best of all, you'll be able to enjoy it both alone and in company. Our goal is to transport you back to those memories and offer an experience that makes you relive the excitement of those titles.


🏆 The Quest for the Golden Loop 

Get ready to embark on a quest to find the Golden Loop, a legendary artifact full of mystery and power. After an accident leaves your ship stranded in the Lost World, you'll need to collect Loops to unlock access to the Space HUB and explore unique worlds. Each Loop you gather will not only bring you closer to the Golden Loop, but will also reveal more about the vast universe around you!

🌍 New Worlds to Explore

Get ready to discover new worlds, such as the Space HUB and its super high climb, Western Bandits, where you'll have to dodge Wild West bandits, and the terrifyingly fun Manor Island. In addition, we have improved all existing maps, adding more playable and exciting content.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44412855/8cf0ce901afdcb75136ab6b6d83db79ada60e25b.gif

🛠️ New mechanics

The Power-Ups you knew have evolved: now you can use the Hammer to stun other players and the Bomb to push them, adding an extra dose of fun to PvP challenges. You will also be able to use the Grappling Hook to defeat the Aliens that invade different areas of the worlds - beware!
We have added a new secondary action, which will allow you to spin in the air and reach further. And if you combine it with the Umbrella... How far do you think you'll be able to go?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44412855/718c22c490e98ff66a697479a2e6ef26a6cfabd7.gif

🖥️ Interfaces Rework

Not only have we improved the gameplay content, but we've also completely overhauled the 2D visual aspect of the game! We’ve completely redesigned the HUD and menus to make the experience smoother, more intuitive, and visually appealing.

Now, navigating through the menus and tracking your progress will be easier than ever, and the new visual design will immerse you even further into the universe. We want every moment in the game, from gameplay to menu navigation, to be as enjoyable as it is fun!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44412855/c9d3df26100681c90b4327bb207762ff62546736.png

🎮 A Game for Everyone

At eWorlds, our goal is simple: to create a place where everyone can have fun. We don't have any big pretensions, we just want you to have a great time, whether you're playing alone or with friends.💜 And remember, the game is totally free!✨

So, get ready for a new eWorlds experience! We can't wait for you to try it out. Your feedback has been crucial, and we are here to keep improving and creating unforgettable moments together.💞

Thank you for being part of our community and for joining us on this adventure!🌟

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44412855/4f6b59f5f7e1799642908d35b2024cf97eb4e5e7.gif

notes.title: Big changes coming to eWorlds!✨
notes.content:
Hey, eWorlds adventurers!🚀We have some incredible news to share!

eWorlds is officially set to launch in Q4 2024! 🎉

As we work toward this milestone, we’re making some big changes to ensure the game is as awesome as it can be.

After carefully considering the feedback from our community, we’ve decided to shift the focus of the project. We’ve realized that eWorlds will not be able to continue as a Game as a Service, so we’re scaling it down to a smaller, more focused experience. We’re also skipping Early Access and going straight to Full Release, so we’re focused on delivering a polished, complete game.

In the lead-up to launch, we’ll be adding new worlds for you to explore, packed with cool challenges and surprises. We’re also introducing fresh gameplay experiences that will bring more fun to your adventure. And to make things even better, we’re cranking up the adventure vibes to make sure you’re hooked every step of the way.

This is just the beginning! At the end of September, we’ll be dropping all the details in a full update, so be sure to stay tuned.👀

Thank you for your support and excitement as we approach this exciting chapter. We can’t wait for you to experience everything we’ve been working on!✨

notes.title: 🌐 This month in eWorlds 🚀: ¡New features and maps! 🎉
notes.content:
Hello there! How was your February? We have been busy working on  upgrades and updates focused on the Demo we will be showcasing on Steam Next Fest this June.


This month we will be talking about:


 Updates on our Steam Page.
 Online play upgrades.
 Map Rework and New Developments.
 eWorlds:  “Did you know?”


Steam page update 🎮
[hr][/hr]
Have you visited our Steam Page yet? We’ve updated it with new images, game renders and spectacular GIFs! And, on top of that, very soon we will be able to share with you the new trailer we are working on…

Take a look and remember to Wishlist and Follow eWorlds on STEAM. It helps us a lot! 💜

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44412855/72d2c83be04d790e2da37e4df747a1925ae2429e.gif

Online Play upgrades 📡
[hr][/hr]
We are still adding features and improving our online game system: Now your emotes will be seen by other players, so you will be able to cheer them when they complete a mission they are stuck on… Or you could mock them after you best them in battle mode  😈 

On top of that, our interactive world events are shared between players! If you need help to unlock a specially hard-to-get Loop, or it’s hard for you to get across a map fast enough after pressing a button, your friends can press it for you to get the prize! This sets the ground for new Co-op puzzles and team game maps so stay tuned to our newsletter…


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44412855/1622f45e4a0b4dd38a474fe19a3d9325334cf29a.gif


New Maps! 🗺️
[hr][/hr]
And, of course, eWorlds keeps growing, and so do the number of maps available to play!


Today we bring you Train Time Trial: a crazy race against time in the cars of a moving train, which you will need to beat as quickly as possible while dodging Lasers, Turrets, and Shocking Ground Tiles!

[table noborder=1  equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [th]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44412855/52529324f693d541cb5fc8fa23a56e40d4923c7b.png[/th]
        [th]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44412855/fbf47e545e4950e8500438dbe7958e33b510c186.png[/th]
    [/tr]
[/table]

Also, check out Bomb Voyage: Face other players in this amusing level while lava keeps going up! Throw bombs to break the ground under your enemies feet while dodging the ones they send your way… Will you be the last one standing to get the trophy in each round?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44412855/dc467e8a879d4ea7516a950788f906d3dd902a8b.png

Last but not least: Two levels that have cleared the sketching stage, Lost World Hub and Western Renegades.

Lost World Hub will be a slightly bigger map filled with puzzles, trade missions and portals to reach new maps and activities. 
Western Renegades will be an Adventure type map where you will have to explore and platform around to clear every mission, while you dodge enemy Renegades in our new Stealth puzzles. 

eWorlds: Did you know? ❓
[hr][/hr]
Did you know that eWorlds started being a game with Isometric cameras?

Before getting to work on eWorlds as we know it today, we were working on other formats, also well focused around the Social and multiplayer aspect , but with a different view of the gameplay, much more 2D-like. 

[table noborder=1  equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [th]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44412855/7ce19098f26c020a2390545c7bbfba19312b07ea.png[/th]
        [th]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44412855/cf0c06e5210ff78ace4c1709ff4e2f30556a2fb0.png[/th]
    [/tr]
[/table]


It wasn’t until 2024 that we decided to turn the game around, leaving the fixed camera angle and 2D puzzles behind, and focusing on a more free and dynamic camera, adding depth with jumps and platforms.


New Wallpaper! 🤗
[hr][/hr]
To celebrate our Steam page updates, we’ve made this new wallpaper. We hope you like it 💜

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44412855/a22bdd5776c190dab0ba430cb36f15087b788ef2.jpg
DOWNLOAD HERE

Do you want to stay tuned on eWorlds and see new content? Follow us on our SOCIAL MEDIA!

eWorlds Team 🚀✨

notes.title: 🌐 This month in eWorlds 🚀: New skins and upgrades! 🎉
notes.content:
Hey eWorlds Community! 🌌🚀

2024 is off to a strong start! We hope your month has been a productive month for you as well, and that you've been able to achieve your New Year's resolutions. 🚀

This month, we've been working on exciting new features and improvements, and we can’t wait to spill the beans on what we've accomplished.  🛠️

 New Skins
 Reworks, content and code improvements.
 About GGtech Studios.
 Blog launch?


New Skins

We know that one of the things you enjoyed the most in the beta was the variety of skins we showcased. That's why we've been working on new designs that we'll introduce in the demo set to launch in June.

We're sharing some concepts and their progression into 3D models with you.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44412855/650e2d2191e5424acca958c2071077b007c717b4.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44412855/18110e2a19f335c82010a9845bf5b68d027b73cd.png


Reworks and improvements

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44412855/7bba82ddbd6f35403f4382e52967e5dbfddc5961.png

Our big goal for eWorlds this month was to make a big optimization of the project. This is a slow process as it involves many departmental dependencies to be executed, but in the long run, it streamlines game development for everyone involved.

The intention is that this will ease the implementation of new features, beef up the game's stability, and squash any potential bugs stemming from this lack of optimization.


About GGTech Studios

Did you know about GGTech Studios and the team that has developed and created eWorlds?

GGTech Studios is a division within GGTech, focused on delivering interactive content, with a special knack for creating video games and social experiences. The team is currently working on over five projects, including eWorlds, crafting diverse content for various audiences.

And our website, where you can find more information about our team and the projects we are developing.

KNOW MORE ABOUT GGTECH STUDIOS


Our Blog is almost ready:

The good news keep coming, we are so much closer to the release of our own official blog. This will be our own space where we will be able to share in detail how a videogame is made behind the scenes. Also it will be another one of our main channels where we will be sharing exciting news, events and all sorts of activities.

We hope you are as excited as we are and will accompany us from the beginning to create a wonderful community.


You don’t have our Wallpapers yet?
🎁

Spice up your screen with a touch of awesomeness!

Do you want to know more about eWorlds? Follow us at our  SOCIAL MEDIA!!


That's all for now! 🙌Thank you for being there 🙌 Without you, none of this would be possible!💜

The eWorlds Crew🚀✨

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44412855/7160c8589ea2dd3c3227d8ae2340fa2ab24a736c.jpg

What You Didn't Know About eWorlds 🌐🎮

To give you more insight into eWorlds, we've crafted a space called "What You Didn't Know About eWorlds", where we'll be sharing different curiosities about the origins and essence of eWorlds.

Today, we are telling you about the very first world we brought to life – Lost World. This journey began about 8 months ago, drawing inspiration from the initial levels of classic platform games like Mario 64. You know those tutorial levels set in lush green meadows, surrounded by nature and plants? That's the vibe we were going for!

Lost World started as a huge map, evolving gradually into its final version. We gathered all the lessons learned during its development and synthesized them into a simpler, more enjoyable experience. 

Following the success of this initial tutorial map, we're now crafting a final version of Lost World that offers a variety of experiences within a single map. From this map, you can explore adventurous challenges, dive into time trials, or compete against other players in battle mode – it's all happening in one epic map!

Stay tuned for more intriguing facts about our game! 🌐🎮


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44412855/0926515017ceba8caebea0f357124401137c833b.png

🛠️Technical Improvements🛠️

As we wrap up Q4 2023 and kick off Q1 2024, our dev team is laser-focused on:
[olist]
 Enhancing gameplay and overall game feel.
 Fine-tuning camera movement.
 Full controller integration.
[/olist]


📰Upcoming news 📰

 🛍️ Store Integration: The store will be the place to spend your loops and coins, and to find exclusive skins, and much more!

 🚀 New Maps: We will improve the maps that were most popular in the beta, based on the feedback received, and also create new ones for each game mode.

 🎨 New Skins: More customization for everyone! We plan to continue producing unique skins so you always have a variety to choose from.

 🎮 Steam Fest: We will participate in the June Steam Fest, the gaming festival that Steam makes every few months, where we will showcase eWorlds with the latest developments we've been working on before launching our Early Access.

 🌟 Social Pass: We are developing a way to access exclusive content, improved social features, the possibility to support game developers, and interact with your favorite creators.


We've crafted exclusive wallpapers just for you!🎁

Our Gamergy merch stole the spotlight, and we know many of you couldn't make it to the event.

That's why we thought it'd be a fantastic idea to create these special wallpapers for our entire community – for everyone sharing each step of our journey with us.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44412855/953b8f85c5e95a0d6ca94c99f89b0acc3836669d.png
DOWNLOAD THEM HERE

That's all for now! 🙌Thank you for being there 🙌 Without you, none of this would be possible!💜

The eWorlds Crew🚀✨

¡Hello eWorlds Community! 🌌🚀

The launch of our Clossed Beta has been an adventure from start to finish, all thanks to you! 💜

Lots of people played eWorlds during the closed beta, streamers shared their first impressions of the game, we reached the Top 10 on Twitch in the platform games category, and we received a very positive response from our community, which motivates us to keep working to create better experiences.

Now, we are preparing to find a balance between our vision and your feedback, as we believe it is the key to make eWorlds an incredible game.

Here we tell you everything that happened and some things that are yet to come: 


 Launch of our Closed Beta.
 Review of the launch.
 eWorlds in GAMERGY 2023.
 Upcoming news. 


Launch of the eWorlds Clossed Beta

 Adventure: 6 Maps

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44412855/1996c00f20a62efed64f152a4e5ae65326a74743.gif

 Hammer: The powerful hammer allows you to deliver melee attacks to crush your enemies or demolish obstacles in your path.

 Umbrella: This umbrella enables you to glide through the air, maintaining control as you descend. Use it to explore new horizons.
